name: NASA APOD Wallpaper & Theme
author: hoowot
description: Sets NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day as your wallpaper every day and themes your workstation to match it, with today's title in the bar. Right-click the widget to start using the theme.

barWidget.description: Today's NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day. Builds a nasa-apod theme from it daily; right-click to use it as your theme, click to open the picture's page.

schema.label: Switch to the APOD theme automatically
schema.description: Off (default): the plugin keeps the nasa-apod theme up to date but never switches to it on its own. Right-click the widget, or pick it in the theme switcher, to start using it. On: switch to the nasa-apod theme as soon as the widget loads and whenever a new picture arrives.

schema.label: Show title in the bar
schema.description: Show today's title next to the icon. Off shows the icon only; the title is still in the tooltip.
